discovery_notes: Search-snippet leads only; Disney Pins Blog is near-sole source, with TDR Explorer, Travel to the Magic, Chip and Co, WDWNT, MyPinCentral, Collectible PinTrader and Disney Pin Forum. SHDR New Year's 2018 pins (released Dec 2017) are keyed in 215, not repeated. SHDR first-anniversary mystery pins split one-per-character without explicit source statement. Disney Pin Forum items (HKDL Christmas 2017, Halloween Gelatoni/jumbo) are forum-only leads. Resellers (suruga-ya, worthpoint, usshoppingsos, picclick, whatnot, fryguypins, parkscollectibles) not used. Budget: 30 searches.
